items.ex: The instructions were so ambiguous that two students understood them in opposite ways.
items.exko: 설명이 너무 모호해서 두 학생이 정반대로 이해했어요.

items.ex: Tom was reluctant to speak in public, so he asked his friend to give the speech instead.
items.exko: 톰은 사람들 앞에서 말하기를 꺼려서 친구에게 대신 연설해 달라고 부탁했어요.

items.ex: Water is vital to all living things; without it, no creature can survive.
items.exko: 물은 모든 생물에게 필수적이에요. 물이 없으면 어떤 생물도 살아남을 수 없어요.

items.ex: Fish were abundant in the river, and every fisherman went home with a full basket.
items.exko: 그 강에는 물고기가 풍부해서 모든 어부가 바구니를 가득 채워 돌아갔어요.

items.ex: The bridge is only a temporary one; a permanent bridge will replace it next year.
items.exko: 그 다리는 임시로 만든 것이고, 내년에 영구적인 다리로 바뀔 거예요.

items.ex: The change in her mood was so subtle that only her closest friends noticed it.
items.exko: 그녀의 기분 변화는 너무 미묘해서 가장 친한 친구들만 알아챘어요.

items.ex: It was obvious that he had been crying, since his eyes were red and swollen.
items.exko: 그의 눈이 붉게 부어 있었기 때문에 그가 울었다는 것은 명백했어요.

items.ex: The painting looked genuine, and experts confirmed it was made by the famous artist himself.
items.exko: 그 그림은 진짜처럼 보였고, 전문가들은 유명한 화가가 직접 그린 것이라고 확인했어요.

items.ex: These boots are durable enough to last for many years of hard hiking.
items.exko: 이 부츠는 오랜 세월 험한 산행을 견딜 만큼 내구성이 있어요.

items.ex: The villagers were hostile to the strangers and refused to give them food or shelter.
items.exko: 마을 사람들은 낯선 이들에게 적대적이어서 음식과 잠자리를 내주기를 거부했어요.

items.ex: It was reckless of him to drive so fast on the icy road without a seatbelt.
items.exko: 안전벨트도 매지 않고 빙판길에서 그렇게 빨리 운전한 것은 무모한 일이었어요.

items.ex: The trip is optional, so students who prefer to stay home do not have to join.
items.exko: 그 여행은 선택 사항이라서 집에 있고 싶은 학생은 참가하지 않아도 돼요.

items.ex: A flexible schedule lets workers choose when they start and finish each day.
items.exko: 유연한 일정 덕분에 근로자들은 매일 시작하고 끝내는 시간을 고를 수 있어요.

items.ex: The glass was so transparent that birds often flew into it without seeing it.
items.exko: 그 유리는 너무 투명해서 새들이 보지 못하고 자주 부딪혔어요.

items.ex: The valley has fertile soil, so farmers there grow rice and vegetables easily.
items.exko: 그 계곡은 땅이 비옥해서 농부들이 쌀과 채소를 쉽게 길러요.

items.ex: Doctors face an ethical question when a patient's wishes differ from the family's.
items.exko: 환자의 바람이 가족의 바람과 다를 때 의사들은 윤리적인 문제에 부딪혀요.

items.ex: Don't waste time arguing about such a trivial matter as who sits by the window.
items.exko: 누가 창가에 앉는지 같은 사소한 일로 다투며 시간을 낭비하지 마세요.

items.ex: Fresh water is scarce in the desert, so travelers carry as much as they can.
items.exko: 사막에서는 신선한 물이 부족해서 여행자들은 가능한 한 많이 가지고 다녀요.

items.ex: The mayor's plan to close the old library was highly controversial, and the town split into two camps.
items.exko: 오래된 도서관을 닫으려는 시장의 계획은 논란이 매우 컸고, 마을은 두 편으로 갈라졌어요.

items.ex: One consequence of skipping breakfast is that you may feel tired before lunch.
items.exko: 아침을 거르면 점심 전에 피곤해질 수 있다는 결과가 따라요.

items.ex: The police needed more evidence before they could say who had broken the window.
items.exko: 경찰은 누가 창문을 깼는지 말하기 전에 더 많은 증거가 필요했어요.

items.ex: A growing trend among teenagers is to share photos instead of sending long messages.
items.exko: 십 대들 사이에서 긴 메시지 대신 사진을 공유하는 경향이 커지고 있어요.

items.ex: Lack of money was the biggest obstacle to her dream of studying abroad.
items.exko: 돈이 부족한 것이 유학을 가겠다는 그녀의 꿈에 가장 큰 장애물이었어요.

items.ex: For the new doctor, the patients' safety is always the first priority.
items.exko: 새로 온 의사에게는 환자의 안전이 언제나 가장 우선이에요.

items.ex: A rainbow is a natural phenomenon caused by sunlight passing through raindrops.
items.exko: 무지개는 햇빛이 빗방울을 통과하면서 생기는 자연 현상이에요.

items.ex: Reading history from a child's perspective helped me see the war in a new way.
items.exko: 아이의 관점에서 역사를 읽자 전쟁을 새로운 방식으로 보게 되었어요.

items.ex: The scientist's hypothesis was that plants grow faster under blue light, and the experiment tested it.
items.exko: 그 과학자의 가설은 식물이 푸른 빛 아래에서 더 빨리 자란다는 것이었고, 실험이 이를 검증했어요.

items.ex: The school celebrates cultural diversity with a festival where students share food from many countries.
items.exko: 그 학교는 학생들이 여러 나라의 음식을 나누는 축제로 문화적 다양성을 기념해요.

items.ex: The company offers a bonus as an incentive for workers who finish projects early.
items.exko: 그 회사는 프로젝트를 일찍 끝낸 직원에게 장려책으로 보너스를 줘요.

items.ex: The restaurant has a good reputation, and people travel from far away to eat there.
items.exko: 그 식당은 평판이 좋아서 사람들이 멀리서 찾아와 식사해요.

items.ex: Her parents made a great sacrifice by selling their house to pay for her education.
items.exko: 그녀의 부모님은 딸의 교육비를 대려고 집을 팔아 큰 희생을 치렀어요.

items.ex: His ambition is to become an astronaut and walk on Mars someday.
items.exko: 그의 야망은 우주비행사가 되어 언젠가 화성 위를 걷는 것이에요.

items.ex: The conflict between the two neighbors began over a fence and lasted for years.
items.exko: 두 이웃 사이의 갈등은 울타리 때문에 시작되어 수년간 이어졌어요.

items.ex: Oil is a valuable natural resource, but it will not last forever.
items.exko: 석유는 소중한 천연자원이지만 영원히 지속되지는 않아요.

items.ex: Planting trees along the road can help mitigate the noise from passing cars.
items.exko: 도로를 따라 나무를 심으면 지나가는 차의 소음을 완화하는 데 도움이 될 수 있어요.

items.ex: Constant rumors can undermine a team's trust in its leader.
items.exko: 끊임없는 소문은 팀이 지도자에게 갖는 신뢰를 약화시킬 수 있어요.

items.ex: Heavy snow may hinder rescue workers from reaching the village.
items.exko: 폭설은 구조대원들이 마을에 도착하는 것을 방해할 수 있어요.

items.ex: Adding a few pictures can enhance your presentation and keep the audience interested.
items.exko: 사진 몇 장을 더하면 발표가 한층 나아지고 청중의 관심을 붙잡을 수 있어요.

items.ex: Don't assume that everyone shares your opinion; ask them first.
items.exko: 모두가 너와 같은 의견일 거라고 가정하지 말고 먼저 물어보세요.

items.ex: Children acquire their first language simply by listening to the people around them.
items.exko: 아이들은 주변 사람들의 말을 듣는 것만으로 모국어를 습득해요.

items.ex: He tried to conceal his disappointment behind a smile, but his voice gave it away.
items.exko: 그는 미소 뒤에 실망감을 숨기려 했지만 목소리가 그것을 드러내고 말았어요.

items.ex: His story seems to contradict what the witness told the police yesterday.
items.exko: 그의 이야기는 어제 목격자가 경찰에게 한 말과 모순되는 것 같아요.

items.ex: Twins can be so alike that even their teachers cannot distinguish one from the other.
items.exko: 쌍둥이는 너무 닮아서 선생님들조차 한 명을 다른 한 명과 구별하지 못할 수 있어요.

items.ex: The coach likes to emphasize teamwork more than individual skill.
items.exko: 그 코치는 개인 기술보다 팀워크를 강조하는 것을 좋아해요.

items.ex: With hard work, you can overcome almost any fear.
items.exko: 노력하면 거의 모든 두려움을 극복할 수 있어요.

items.ex: An officer will inspect every bag at the airport before the passengers board.
items.exko: 공항에서는 승객이 탑승하기 전에 직원이 모든 가방을 꼼꼼히 검사해요.

items.ex: I tried to persuade my father to let me adopt a puppy, but he said no.
items.exko: 나는 아버지를 설득해 강아지를 입양하려 했지만 아버지는 안 된다고 하셨어요.

items.ex: The teacher used a model to demonstrate how volcanoes erupt.
items.exko: 선생님은 모형을 사용해 화산이 어떻게 폭발하는지 보여 주셨어요.

items.ex: Many residents oppose the plan to build a factory next to the river.
items.exko: 많은 주민이 강 바로 옆에 공장을 짓겠다는 계획에 반대해요.

items.ex: If you neglect your health when you are young, you may suffer for it later.
items.exko: 젊을 때 건강을 소홀히 하면 나중에 그 대가를 치를 수 있어요.

items.ex: Animals must adapt to cold winters or move to warmer places.
items.exko: 동물들은 추운 겨울에 적응하거나 더 따뜻한 곳으로 이동해야 해요.

items.ex: Nothing can justify cruelty to animals.
items.exko: 그 무엇도 동물에 대한 잔인함을 정당화할 수는 없어요.

items.ex: Everyone in the group should contribute ideas to the final project.
items.exko: 모둠원 모두가 최종 프로젝트에 아이디어를 보태야 해요.

items.ex: The company decided to withdraw the product after customers reported problems.
items.exko: 고객들이 문제를 신고하자 그 회사는 제품을 회수하기로 결정했어요.

items.ex: She deliberately left the door open so the cat could come in.
items.exko: 그녀는 고양이가 들어올 수 있도록 일부러 문을 열어 두었어요.

items.ex: The sky gradually turned from dark blue to pink as the sun came up.
items.exko: 해가 떠오르면서 하늘이 짙은 파랑에서 분홍으로 서서히 변했어요.

items.ex: It was not a mistake; it was merely a different way of solving the problem.
items.exko: 그것은 실수가 아니라 단지 문제를 푸는 다른 방식일 뿐이었어요.

items.ex: I was so tired that I could hardly keep my eyes open.
items.exko: 나는 너무 피곤해서 눈을 거의 뜨고 있을 수 없었어요.

items.good: The instructions were unclear, so we had to read them twice.
items.ko: 설명이 명확하지 않아서 우리는 두 번 읽어야 했어요.
bad: The instructions were inclear, so we had to read them twice.
The instructions were disclear, so we had to read them twice.
The instructions were nonclear, so we had to read them twice.

cz.st: The instructions were ___, so we had to read them twice.

items.rule: 형용사 clear의 반대는 접두사 un-을 붙여 unclear라고 해요.

items.good: It is impossible to finish this report in ten minutes.
items.ko: 이 보고서를 10분 안에 끝내는 것은 불가능해요.
bad: It is unpossible to finish this report in ten minutes.
It is inpossible to finish this report in ten minutes.
It is dispossible to finish this report in ten minutes.

cz.st: It is ___ to finish this report in ten minutes.

items.rule: p 앞에서는 부정 접두사로 in- 대신 im-을 써서 impossible이 돼요.

items.good: The doctor's note was illegible, so the pharmacist called to check it.
items.ko: 의사의 메모를 알아볼 수 없어서 약사가 전화로 확인했어요.
bad: The doctor's note was unlegible, so the pharmacist called to check it.
The doctor's note was inlegible, so the pharmacist called to check it.
The doctor's note was dislegible, so the pharmacist called to check it.

cz.st: The doctor's note was ___, so the pharmacist called to check it.

items.rule: l 앞에서는 in-이 il-로 바뀌어 illegible(읽을 수 없는)이 돼요.

items.good: The shop owner was dishonest about the price of the used phone.
items.ko: 가게 주인은 중고 휴대전화의 가격에 대해 정직하지 않았어요.
bad: The shop owner was unhonest about the price of the used phone.
The shop owner was inhonest about the price of the used phone.
The shop owner was imhonest about the price of the used phone.

cz.st: The shop owner was ___ about the price of the used phone.

items.rule: honest의 반대말은 접두사 dis-를 붙인 dishonest예요.

items.good: The bus runs on an irregular schedule during the holidays.
items.ko: 그 버스는 휴일 동안 불규칙한 시간표로 운행해요.
bad: The bus runs on an unregular schedule during the holidays.
The bus runs on an inregular schedule during the holidays.
The bus runs on an imregular schedule during the holidays.

cz.st: The bus runs on an ___ schedule during the holidays.

items.rule: r 앞에서는 in-이 ir-로 바뀌어 irregular(불규칙한)가 돼요.

items.good: The new law will affect small businesses the most.
items.ko: 새 법은 소규모 사업체에 가장 큰 영향을 미칠 거예요.
bad: The new law will effect small businesses the most.
The new law will affects small businesses the most.
The new law will be affect small businesses the most.

cz.st: The new law will ___ small businesses the most.

items.rule: 동사로 '영향을 미치다'는 affect이고, effect는 주로 명사 '영향, 효과'예요. will 뒤에는 동사원형을 써요.

items.good: Could you lend me your pen for a moment?
items.ko: 잠깐 펜 좀 빌려줄 수 있어요?
bad: Could you borrow me your pen for a moment?
Could you lend to me from your pen for a moment?
Could you lend my your pen for a moment?

cz.st: Could you ___ me your pen for a moment?

items.rule: lend는 '빌려주다'이고 borrow는 '빌리다'예요. lend me ~ 형태로 써요.

items.good: She spoke confidently in front of the whole school.
items.ko: 그녀는 전교생 앞에서 자신 있게 말했어요.
bad: She spoke confident in front of the whole school.
She spoke confidence in front of the whole school.
She spoke confidential in front of the whole school.

cz.st: She spoke ___ in front of the whole school.

items.rule: 동사 spoke를 꾸미려면 형용사가 아닌 부사 confidently를 써요.

items.good: I misread the sign and turned the wrong way.
items.ko: 나는 표지판을 잘못 읽어서 길을 잘못 들었어요.
bad: I unread the sign and turned the wrong way.
I disread the sign and turned the wrong way.
I inread the sign and turned the wrong way.

cz.st: I ___ the sign and turned the wrong way.

items.good: The museum will reopen next month after the repairs.
items.ko: 박물관은 수리가 끝난 뒤 다음 달에 다시 문을 열 거예요.
bad: The museum will disopen next month after the repairs.
The museum will inopen next month after the repairs.
The museum will nonopen next month after the repairs.

cz.st: The museum will ___ next month after the repairs.

items.good: The map was useless because it showed the wrong city.
items.ko: 그 지도는 엉뚱한 도시를 보여 줘서 쓸모가 없었어요.
bad: The map was useful because it showed the wrong city.
The map was usefully because it showed the wrong city.
The map was use because it showed the wrong city.

cz.st: The map was ___ because it showed the wrong city.

items.good: The phone is so cheap that it is affordable for almost everyone.
items.ko: 그 휴대전화는 너무 싸서 거의 모든 사람이 살 수 있어요.
bad: The phone is so cheap that it is afford for almost everyone.
The phone is so cheap that it is affording for almost everyone.
The phone is so cheap that it is affordably for almost everyone.

cz.st: The phone is so cheap that it is ___ for almost everyone.

items.rule: be동사 뒤에는 형용사가 오며, afford에 -able이 붙은 affordable이 '(가격이) 감당할 만한'이에요.

items.good: The reporter tried to stay neutral and did not take either side.
items.ko: 기자는 중립을 지키려고 노력했고 어느 쪽 편도 들지 않았어요.
bad: The reporter tried to stay neutrally and did not take either side.
The reporter tried to stay neutrality and did not take either side.
The reporter tried to stay neutralize and did not take either side.

cz.st: The reporter tried to stay ___ and did not take either side.

items.rule: stay 뒤의 보어 자리에는 형용사가 와요. neutral은 '중립적인'이에요.

items.q: Mina is meticulous; unlike her careless brother, she checks every number twice. What does "meticulous" most likely mean?
o: always in a hurry to leave
items.why: careless brother와 대비되고 숫자를 두 번 확인하므로 '세심한'이에요.

items.q: Although he earns a lot, Mr. Han is frugal and never buys things he does not need. What does "frugal" most likely mean?
items.why: 필요 없는 것은 사지 않는다는 단서에서 '절약하는'임을 알 수 있어요.

items.q: Jun is gregarious; he loves parties and is happiest when surrounded by friends. What does "gregarious" most likely mean?
items.why: 파티와 친구들을 좋아한다는 설명에서 '사교적인'이에요.

items.q: The benevolent old woman gave food and blankets to every homeless person on the street. What does "benevolent" most likely mean?
o: kind and willing to help others
items.why: 음식과 담요를 나눠 주었으므로 '자애로운, 친절한'이에요.

items.q: Typewriters are now obsolete; almost nobody has used them since computers appeared. What does "obsolete" mean here?
items.why: 컴퓨터가 등장한 뒤 거의 아무도 쓰지 않는다는 뜻이므로 '더 이상 쓰이지 않는'이에요.

items.q: A prolific writer, she published over forty novels in thirty years. What does "prolific" most likely mean?
o: producing a great deal of work
hated by most of her readers
famous only in her own town
items.why: 30년간 소설 40여 권을 냈다는 점에서 '다작하는'이에요.

items.q: I appreciate your candid answer; you told me exactly what you thought, even though it was hard to hear. What does "candid" mean?
items.why: 생각을 그대로 말해 주었다는 설명에서 '솔직한'이에요.

items.q: After the long flight, I felt lethargic and could only lie on the sofa. What does "lethargic" most likely mean?
items.why: 소파에 누워 있을 수밖에 없었다는 데서 '무기력한'이에요.

items.q: The lecture was so tedious that half the audience fell asleep. What does "tedious" most likely mean?
items.why: 청중 절반이 잠들었다는 결과에서 '지루한'임을 알 수 있어요.

items.q: The wedding cake was elaborate, with five layers and hundreds of tiny sugar flowers. What does "elaborate" most likely mean?
o: plain and very cheap to make
small enough to carry by hand
items.why: 다섯 층과 수백 개의 설탕 꽃이라는 설명에서 '정교한'이에요.

items.q: As the storm moved away, the sound of thunder began to diminish. What does "diminish" most likely mean?
items.why: 폭풍이 멀어지면서 소리가 점점 작아지므로 '줄어들다'예요.

items.q: The coach gave a speech to bolster the team's confidence before the final. What does "bolster" most likely mean?
items.why: 결승 전 연설의 목적은 자신감을 북돋우는 것이므로 '강화하다'예요.

items.q: Please refrain from using your phones during the performance. What does "refrain from" mean?
items.why: 공연 중 휴대전화를 쓰지 말라는 요청이므로 '삼가다'예요.

items.q: The country decided to abolish the old law that banned women from voting. What does "abolish" mean?
items.why: 여성의 투표를 막던 낡은 법을 없앴다는 뜻이므로 '폐지하다'예요.

items.q: Auditors scrutinize every receipt to be sure no money is missing. What does "scrutinize" mean?
items.why: 돈이 빠졌는지 확인하려고 모든 영수증을 살피는 것이므로 '면밀히 살피다'예요.

items.q: What does the word "unavoidable" mean?
items.why: un-은 '아닌', -able은 '~할 수 있는'이라서 '피할 수 없는'이에요.

items.q: Which word means "to understand wrongly"?
items.why: 접두사 mis-는 '잘못'을 뜻해요.

items.q: Which word means "to pay in advance"?
items.why: 접두사 pre-는 '미리'를 뜻하므로 prepay는 '선불하다'예요.

items.q: What does the word "bilingual" mean?
o: able to learn a language quickly
items.why: bi-는 '둘'을 뜻하므로 '두 언어를 쓸 수 있는'이에요.

items.q: An anti-bullying campaign is a plan that tries to do what?
items.why: 접두사 anti-는 '반대하는'이라는 뜻이라서 '괴롭힘을 막는' 캠페인이에요.

items.q: Which word means "between nations"?
items.why: 접두사 inter-는 '~ 사이'를 뜻하므로 international은 '국가 간의'예요.

items.q: Honesty is an important ___ in our family. Which word best fills the blank?
items.why: '원칙'이라는 명사는 principle이에요. principal은 '교장' 또는 '주요한'이라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: In "kindness", the suffix -ness changes the adjective "kind" into which part of speech?
items.why: -ness는 형용사를 명사로 바꾸는 접미사예요.

items.q: The suffix -ize, as in "modernize", usually forms which part of speech?
items.why: -ize는 '~하게 만들다'라는 동사를 만드는 접미사예요.

items.q: The prefix dis- in "disagree" means which of the following?
items.why: dis-는 반대나 부정을 나타내므로 disagree는 '동의하지 않다'예요.

items.q: Which word correctly means "not patient"?
items.why: p 앞에서는 in-이 im-으로 바뀌어 impatient가 돼요.

items.q: Which word correctly means "not logical"?
items.why: l 앞에서는 in-이 il-로 바뀌어 illogical이 돼요.

items.q: She ___ a great effort to finish the marathon in under four hours. Which verb best fills the blank?
items.why: '노력하다'는 make an effort라고 표현해요.

items.q: We were late for school because of the ___ rain. Which word best fills the blank?
items.why: '폭우'는 heavy rain이라는 짝 표현을 써요.

items.q: Choose the natural phrase: "Let me give you ___ about your essay."
items.why: advice는 셀 수 없는 명사라서 a piece of advice로 세요.

items.q: In "The team came up with a new idea," what does "came up with" mean?
items.why: come up with는 '(생각 등을) 떠올리다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: We had to put off the picnic because of the rain. What does "put off" mean?
items.why: 비 때문에 소풍을 뒤로 미뤘다는 뜻이에요.

items.q: To break the ice at the party, Ben told a funny story. What does "break the ice" mean?
items.why: break the ice는 어색한 분위기를 풀다라는 관용 표현이에요.

items.q: Mia has to hit the books tonight because her exam is tomorrow. What does "hit the books" mean?
items.why: hit the books는 '열심히 공부하다'라는 관용 표현이에요.

items.q: Missing the bus turned out to be a blessing in disguise, since I met my best friend while walking. What does the phrase mean?
o: something good that first seemed bad
a gift wrapped in plain paper
an event that happens every day
items.why: 처음엔 나빠 보였지만 결국 좋은 일이 된 경우를 뜻해요.

items.q: The two sisters rarely see eye to eye about music. What does "see eye to eye" mean?
items.why: see eye to eye는 '의견이 일치하다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: Which word describes careful spending with a NEGATIVE feeling? "My uncle is ___ with his money."
items.why: stingy는 인색하다는 부정적 느낌이고, 나머지는 긍정적이거나 중립적이에요.

items.q: Which word is closest in meaning to "enormous"?
items.why: enormous는 '거대한'이라는 뜻이며 huge와 가장 가까워요.

items.q: Which word is the opposite of "expand"?
items.why: expand는 '확대하다'이고 반대는 '줄어들다'라는 shrink예요.

items.q: Which word does NOT belong with the others?
items.why: whisper, murmur, mutter는 낮은 소리로 말하는 것이고 shout는 큰 소리로 외치는 거예요.
